content:
alex: quick morning async — SLO snapshot and follow-ups.

maria: pulled 24h burn rate. overall SLOs look green but two noisy alerts: rps-fail-rate and kv-cache-miss.

jon: rps-fail-rate spike lines up with last-night frontend deploy (PR #342). i muted the canary alert for 30m while we investigate.

alex: @jon can you drop rollback notes here so we have context for postmortem?

jon: rollback notes: https://redwood.internal/rollbacks/2026-03-16-frontend-deploy — reverted traffic to v1.13, confirmed error rate back to baseline.

priya: oncall saw repeated paging for kv-cache-miss at 02:14 UTC. root cause looks like eviction churn from a batch job. filed INF-1123 and assigned to sam.

sam: picking up INF-1123. immediate mitigation: bump cache size + tune eviction policy, will run canary deploy later today and monitor.

maria: proposed alert tuning: raise kv-cache-miss threshold to 0.8% and add 5m suppression window for transient spikes. i'll open a PR in alerting-config with tests.

alex: can we also add a dashboard tile for cache miss latency? current graphs smooth over short spikes and make triage harder.

priya: +1 — i'll add the tile and attach it to the oncall dashboard.

sam: small ask: need a code review on infra/kv-policy change — @maria @jon PTAL https://git.redwood/infra/kv-policy/pulls/7

jon: i'll review after this async. ping me if it blocks the canary.

deploy-bot: deploy frontend-canary v1.14 started by @jon at 1934567905

alex: reminder: SLO review meeting moved to 16:00 PT. agenda = noisy alerts list + rollback playbook updates + INF-1123 follow-up.

maria: added agenda items and pre-read doc: https://docs.redwood/slo-review/pre-read-2026-03-17

priya: blockers: none major. oncall handoff to @liam at 09:00 PT — will attach runbook notes to the handoff thread.

liam: i'll be oncall after 09:00 PT, thanks for the handoff notes — will watch the canary and INF-1123 dashboard.

alex: thanks everyone. if anything pages, treat pager as priority. otherwise we'll track INF-1123 + alert PRs today. :thumbsup:
